items.name: Langnäse Blütenhonig
items.label: LANGNÄSE
items.description: Parody of the Langnese squeeze honey bottle: fat sun-yellow glossy plastic bottle with an orange flip cap with nozzle, white label band with the brand word LANGNÄSE and a bee

items.name: Bonne Oma Erdbeer-Konfitüre
items.label: BONNE OMA
items.description: Parody of the French Bonne Maman strawberry preserve: glass jar of coral-red jam with a cream lid (gingham wink: a coral inner ring), a cream label with a strawberry and BONNE OMA

items.name: Nutello Nuss-Nougat-Creme
items.label: NUTELLO
items.icon: bread slice with spread and two hazelnuts
items.description: Parody of the famous hazelnut spread: glass jar of chocolate-brown nougat cream with a cream-white screw lid, a big cream label with NUTELLO, a bread slice with spread and two hazelnuts

items.name: Zentus Heidelbeer-Konfitüre
items.label: ZENTUS
items.description: Parody of Zentis fruit preserve: glass jar of cobalt-blue blueberry jam with a sun-yellow gold lid and a cream label with ZENTUS and three big blueberries
